title: hotfix: fix connection leak in slo-enforcer during regional failover
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context: During a high-traffic regional failover exercise we observed the slo-enforcer service leaking outbound connections to the routing backend which led to exhausted file descriptors and SLO enforcement stalls. This PR fixes a connection leak triggered when a backend endpoint returned a 503 with a malformed Retry-After header while the regional failover state machine retried endpoints. Root cause: an error path in endpointIterator.next() returned early without closing the per-attempt transport; the transport was only closed in the success path. Fix: ensure transports are closed on all error/early-return paths and add defensive timeouts around dial + response parsing. Also add a metric to track leaked-transport events and a unit+integration test that simulates the malformed Retry-After case.

Changeset summary: small focused hotfix touching the slo-enforcer runtime and a test harness. Includes production-safe rollout notes and backout steps.
commits: a1f4d2e: fix(endpointIterator): close transport on error paths
b2e7c9d: add defensive parse for Retry-After and fallback to default backoff
c3d6f1a: add metric slo_enforcer_leaked_transports_total and increment on leak detection
d4e5b6c: test(slo-enforcer): integration test for malformed Retry-After during failover
e5f6a7b: docs: add rollout and rollback notes to changelog
review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Please add a unit test for endpointIterator.next() early-return paths. Also ensure transports are closed before metric incrementation to avoid double-counting.
Priya Nair: Added integration test and moved metric increment after transport close. See commit c3d6f1a and d4e5b6c.
María Gómez: Verified timeouts look safe for production; suggest monitoring the new metric for the next 48h on staging before canary.
Wei Zhang: Confirmed no user-visible API changes. Approving for merge after staging canary.
CI: flaky_test_runner failed once; re-ran and all checks passed.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fixes a connection leak in the slo-enforcer that could surface during regional failover when a backend returns a malformed Retry-After header. Adds metric slo_enforcer_leaked_transports_total and safeguards. Rolled out to staging and canary before global merge.
testing: Unit tests added for endpointIterator early-return paths. Integration test simulates regional failover with malformed Retry-After and verifies transports are closed and metric increments. Staging canary ran for 24h with no regression. Load test at 2x baseline showed stable SLO enforcement.
rollout_plan: 1) Deploy to staging and monitor slo_enforcer_leaked_transports_total for 24 hours. 2) Canary on 10% of regional traffic for 2 hours with automated rollback on increase in leaked transports or SLO violations. 3) If stable, promote to 100% over 30 minutes. Backout: revert to previous release using rollback toggle in orchestration config.
impact: Fix prevents SLO enforcement stalls and potential regional cascading failures; low risk change (small surface area) but prioritized as hotfix due to availability impact during failover.
notes: No breaking API changes. Added defensive parsing to be tolerant of malformed headers. Team on-call notified and postmortem linked to SUP-1975. Recommend retaining the new metric for 14d of retention.
